# duckdb-healpix function reference

1 function(s). All angles are degrees, ICRS, `DOUBLE`.
All pixel indices are NESTED, `BIGINT`. Order is `INT` in `[0, 29]`.

## Pixel functions

### `hpx_ang2pix`

```sql
hpx_ang2pix(order INTEGER, ra DOUBLE, dec DOUBLE) -> BIGINT
```

NESTED HEALPix index of an ICRS position at the given order. Order must be in [0,29]; ra in [0,360); dec in [-90,90]. Returns NULL if any argument is NULL.

```sql
SELECT hpx_ang2pix(12, 266.405, -28.936); -- 118088310
```
